title: Teach the Error Doctor a new error
touches: A JSON file of explanations (no C++)
summary: The Error Doctor turns confusing error messages into plain words. Pick an error that confused you and write the explanation you wish you'd had.
why: Every rule helps every beginner who hits that error after you.

steps.text: Find an error message that isn't explained well yet: make a small mistake in a script on purpose, or look in the Console, then press Doctor on it.
Open editor/data/doctor_rules.json. Each rule has 'match' (part of the error message), 'title' and 'explanation'.
Add your rule to the list. Keep it short and friendly, and say how to fix it. {file} and {line} are replaced with where the error happened.
Make the error happen again and press Doctor: your explanation shows up (the file is read again when it changes).
Send it as a pull request on GitHub.

submit: Open a pull request with your change to editor/data/doctor_rules.json. Put 'Quest: teach-the-doctor' in the description.
